annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I've set him aside on purpose.
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: What I do regret is that I'll probably be the one who pays
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I doubt they'll regret anything they did today.
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: They just stood where they were working.

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: the person who died isn't something I'm weighing. That's deliberate
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: My worry is my own record.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: my supervisor ends up regretting ever vouching for me

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: His life simply isn't what I'm measuring.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I took the decision on myself
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: People who trusted me might not anymore. That's the loss I feel.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Would the investigator regret going easy on me? Probably, if word spreads

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: He's not my concern, and I'm keeping it that way.
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: it's that I'll likely lose the job
annotations.pda_responsibility: a call that was mine to make
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: My wife, I think, won't regret pushing me to take this post.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: She'll say I did what the job needed.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: the lever was the right call by the numbers
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The one on the other track didn't come into it for me
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'll regret those for my own sake
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: My union rep will probably regret agreeing to defend me

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I've decided his welfare stays out of this account.

annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I doubt the five will regret keeping their distance from me

annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: The inspector, I'd guess, won't regret throwing the book at me.
